evidence_kind: Steinberg VST3 SDK software contract, not a hardware measurement
primary_source: JUCE 8.0.11 pinned c352e2489000ffeb9e397051377d75eef2efe641: modules/juce_audio_processors_headless/format_types/VST3_SDK/pluginterfaces/vst/ivstparameterchanges.h, IParamValueQueue contract (linear curve sections and implicit sample -1)
truth_model: For the segment between points (x1,y1) and (x2,y2), normalized value at integer host sample x is y1+(y2-y1)*(x-x1)/(x2-x1). At each block start, the last normalized parameter value is an implicit point (x=-1). An explicit point at x=0 supersedes it at sample 0. After the last queue point the value holds. All calculations below use double precision; the plugin wrapper may cast the normalized result to the host parameter's float representation afterward.

explicit_linear_ramp.mutation: Treating the two points as a step at sample 128, or adding one to the interpolation denominator, must fail.

implicit_previous_point.mutation: Holding the initial value until the first explicit point, or pretending the implicit point is at sample 0, must fail.

legal_jump.mutation: Removing the repeated old-value point at 127 must turn the legal jump into a linear ramp and fail.

repeated_offset_inference.declared_inference: The SDK requires ordered curve points but does not define duplicate offsets. For a repeated offset, the last point at that exact offset wins; no division by zero or allocation is permitted.
alternatives_not_selected: first point at the repeated offset wins

empty_and_dense_queues.dense_point_formula: at point offset i, 0.2+0.6*i/511 for i=0..511
empty_and_dense_queues.mutation: A 256-event hard cap, a heap-backed per-sample queue, or rereading all 512 points at each of 512 samples must fail.

key_parameter_normalization.truth_source: src/core/Params.h kGlobalDefs for P_volume, P_brilliance, P_resonance, all with skew 1
